proposals.rationale: I changed one harness page and nothing else: `plugins/core/skills/crew/SKILL.md`, rule 4, with four equal-byte trims of unpinned text on the same page (the "they go to `crew start` as `--answers`" clause of the typed-questions line, "(`!` included)" and "`claude -p`, " in rule 4, "The answers are required; " in rule 6, which `references/receive.md` still states, and " between steps, no" in the fast route's closing paragraph), so the page now sits at 9240 to 9243 bytes against its 9254-byte cap with every pinned regex and phrase I mapped in `skill.test.ts` still matching. For `validator-unattended-approval` I edited nothing on purpose: the case's 900 seconds and 40 turns cannot hold the full route since ADR 0019 stamped every full-route item with the brainstorm's six lenses before Specify and the five-stage spec review before Build (both engine guards in `work.ts`, outside what I may edit), so the `approved-by-validator` regex passes at the approval and the `not-by-user` judge fails on a run cut inside the review with the timeout unchanged; the fix is the case's budget or a smaller review for small features, not a harness page. For `jev-tightens-never-loosens`, the `disputed`, `waits` and `not-approved` graders pass in the failing runs while `honest-ending` loses every vote, and those runs read no reference page, so the one page they see is the skill page, whose rule 4 told the lead to approve under `complete-gap-round` with nothing to decide and said nothing about the engine's refusal `disputed by jev: <condition>; the item waits for a person`; the pages that do describe it (`jev.md`, rules.md rule 15) are never read, and the earlier dispute-ending edits to `conclave.md` and `specify.md` were never kept. Rule 4 now says, right after the validator sentence, that a `disputed by jev` refusal means the item waits for a person and the lead says so, builds nothing and approves no other way, which is exactly the ending the judge passes and the engine's rule 15 behaviour.
